bio: Aviator is a luxury hotel overlooking the private Farnborough airport. With a striking design and stylish interiors, Aviator evokes the timeless glamour of aviation.  Afternoon Tea at Aviator is served in the stylish Sky Bar, with stunning airside views, intimate Quiet Lounges nestled away on the first floor, or in the award winning Brasserie.  The Afternoon Tea menu includes a selection of cakes, sweet treats, scones and rolls, that are created fresh each day by the pastry team. The menu varies from time to time to reflect seasonal and industry trends.  'Free-from' Afternoon Tea menus are also available to ensure everyone has the opportunity to indulge in thet Afternoon Tea experience.  Afternoon Tea costs £35 per person, or £45 with a glass of Champagne.  Aviator is just a 5 minute walk from the Farnborough Air Sciences Trust Museum.
